title: Teaching LLMs to Learn Tool Trialing and Execution through Environment Interaction
authors_zh: Xingjie Gao、Pengcheng Huang、Zhenghao Liu、Yukun Yan、Shuo Wang、Zulong Chen、Chen Qian、Ge Yu、Yu Gu
paper_type_zh: 工具交互轨迹构造与混合反馈训练研究
best_for_zh: 研究工具使用示范、探索行为、自我纠错和模型评审奖励的读者。
one_line: ToolMaster releases trial-and-execution SFT conversations and trains tool-use policies with teacher-filtered demonstrations followed by GRPO using format and model-judged correctness rewards.
ToolMaster 发布试用与执行相结合的工具示范会话，先进行监督微调，再使用格式与模型正确性奖励进行 GRPO。
why: It distinguishes reusable interaction demonstrations from online policy rollouts and makes the learned judge, behavior filter, and environment feedback part of the data contract.
inclusion_reason: A concrete teacher-trajectory construction and mixed-feedback recipe that turns tool trialing, execution, and self-correction into SFT conversations and agent-policy training.

title: Problem
问题
html: Static expert trajectories can teach a tool-use path without teaching an agent how to investigate an unfamiliar API. ToolMaster studies this robustness problem by changing the interaction demonstrations themselves: a query is paired with an exploratory trial phase and an execution phase that can recover from errors. For this atlas, the object of interest is the resulting conversation and its filtering/reward contract, rather than only the trained checkpoint. Primary paper, Sections 1 and 3.
固定的专家轨迹可能只教会某条工具调用路径，而没有教会模型如何了解陌生接口。ToolMaster 通过改变交互示范来研究这一问题：先试用工具，再结合试用经验执行任务，并在执行出错时纠正。本卡关注示范会话、筛选条件与奖励契约，而不只关注训练后的模型。依据为原论文第一节、第三节。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The teacher first probes tools and observes their responses, then solves the task using the accumulated experience. Trial and execution sub-trajectories are concatenated into a demonstration. SFT introduces these behaviors, and GRPO later coordinates the phases using format and correctness feedback. The persistent learned object is the policy; within-run self-correction is a behavior represented in the training records, not an independent guarantee of success.
教师模型先调用工具探查其行为并记录观察，再利用这些经验完成用户任务。试用与执行子轨迹拼接为示范，先进行监督微调，再用 GRPO 协调两个阶段。持久变化发生在模型策略参数中；单次运行中的自我纠错只是训练轨迹所表达的行为，并不构成正确性保证。

title: Method
方法
html: Section 3.2 and Appendix A.2 describe DeepSeek-V3.1 synthesis and filtering for success, global planning, explicit tool exploration, and self-correction. Section 4 selects 1,500 SFT queries and 800 RL queries from ToolBench training. The pinned public JSON has 1,444 query records and one conversation instance per query, with query, query_id, tool_doc, and instances fields. Each conversation contains role/content turns. The difference from the selected-query count is recorded without guessing its cause.
第三节与附录说明使用 DeepSeek-V3.1 生成轨迹，并筛选任务成功、整体规划、明确试用与自我纠错等行为。论文从 ToolBench 训练集选择 1,500 个问题用于监督微调、800 个问题用于强化学习。固定提交中的公开文件实际包含 1,444 个问题记录，每个问题有一份会话实例；字段包括问题、问题编号、工具文档和实例，会话保存角色与内容。数量差异的原因未知，不推测为某一种过滤造成。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The Qwen2.5-7B ablation in Table 3 reports StableToolBench average SoPR 66.37 for the full method, 58.52 without SFT, and 59.72 without RL. These support the contribution of both training stages in that setup. They are model-and-protocol-specific results, not proof that every new API or deployment will improve. StableToolBench/TMDB evaluation uses GPT-4o judgment, whereas ToolHop checks answer containment; those score definitions should not be conflated.
表三在 Qwen2.5-7B 上的消融报告：完整方法的 StableToolBench 平均 SoPR 为 66.37，去掉监督微调为 58.52，去掉强化学习为 59.72。这说明该设置下两个阶段都有贡献，不能外推为所有接口或部署都必然改善。StableToolBench 与 TMDB 使用 GPT-4o 评审，ToolHop 则检查答案包含关系，需区分这些得分定义。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The data recipe explicitly includes tool investigation before goal-directed execution, rather than only imitating successful direct solutions. Error-recovery behavior is retained as part of a successful demonstration, and online RL uses the same overall trial/execution paradigm. This changes which behavior the corpus teaches. It does not make the terminal correctness reward programmatically verifiable: the paper uses a capable model to judge whether the query was resolved.
这套数据构造方案把执行前的工具试用和执行中的错误恢复写进示范，而非仅保留直接成功的调用路径，改变了语料要教会的行为。在线强化学习继续协调试用与执行，但最终正确性仍由模型判断；存在可执行工具反馈，并不意味着最终奖励是完全可程序验证的。

title: Limitations
局限
html: A tool response is evidence about an invocation, not proof that the whole task succeeded. The teacher/verifier can accept weak trajectories or reject useful ones. API state, cache behavior, prompts, and judge versions can affect reproduction. The public SFT file count is verified, but the exact selected-query-to-release mapping, complete historical RL rollout lineage, and standalone derived-data license remain unknown. No end-to-end GPU reproduction was attempted for this card.
工具返回值只能证明一次调用的反馈，不能独立证明任务完整完成。教师与评审可能误收或误拒轨迹；接口状态、缓存、提示词和评审版本也可能改变复现结果。公开示范文件的记录数已核实，但选中问题到发布记录的对应关系、完整历史强化学习轨迹谱系及衍生数据的独立许可仍未知。本卡没有进行端到端训练复现。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use the pinned conversations as examples of exploratory and error-recovery demonstrations, and inspect the behavioral filter before adapting the recipe to a new tool set. They are relevant to SFT and agent-policy training. If reproducing GRPO, preserve the learned correctness judge and distinguish it from the format checker. Classification is mixed feedback and reinforcement learning, rather than treating model-judged answer success as deterministic RLVR.
适合研究如何把探索和错误恢复写入工具使用的监督示范。迁移到新工具集前应先审查行为筛选提示词；复现 GRPO 时要保留模型正确性评审，并与格式检查区分。本卡将其归为混合反馈与智能体强化学习，不把模型评审的成功奖励等同于确定性的可验证奖励。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the synthesis prompt and trajectory-filter prompt together with the actual released schema. Keep three model roles separate: DeepSeek-V3.1 synthesis/filtering, DeepSeek-V3 correctness reward in the paper training setup, and GPT-4o benchmark judgment. Also distinguish the 1,500 selected SFT queries reported by the paper from the 1,444 records counted in the pinned release. Tool observations and full-episode outcome rewards have different granularity.
建议把数据合成提示词、轨迹筛选提示词和实际公开格式对照阅读，并区分三种模型角色：DeepSeek-V3.1 用于合成与筛选，论文中的 DeepSeek-V3 用于强化学习正确性奖励，GPT-4o 用于部分基准评审。还应区分论文选择的 1,500 个监督问题和发布文件中的 1,444 个问题记录，以及工具观察与整条轨迹结果奖励的不同粒度。
